description: Updates an existing Sentry release's details for an organization, including its reference, URL, release date, associated commits, or repository references.

commits.description: List of commit data to associate or update for this release; can add new commits or modify existing ones if Sentry's commit tracking needs adjustment.

author_email.description: The email address of the commit author.
author_email.title: Author Email

author_name.description: The name of the commit author.
author_name.title: Author Name

id.description: The unique identifier of the commit (e.g., a SHA hash).
id.title: Id

patch_set.description: List of objects representing file changes (patches) included in this commit. Each object specifies the file path and type of change.

path.description: The path of the file that was changed in the commit.
path.title: Path

type.description: The type of change made to the file (e.g., 'A' for added, 'M' for modified, 'D' for deleted).
type.title: Type

patch_set.title: Patch Set

repository.description: The name or identifier of the repository the commit belongs to. Optional if only one repository is configured for the Sentry project.
repository.title: Repository

timestamp.description: The timestamp of the commit in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-10-26T10:00:00Z').
timestamp.title: Timestamp

commits.title: Commits

dateReleased.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the release went live (e.g., '2023-10-26T10:00:00Z'). If not provided, Sentry uses the current time, but an existing dateReleased will not be overwritten unless a new value is provided.
dateReleased.title: Date Released

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique ID or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

ref.description: Commit reference (e.g., a branch name, tag, or commit SHA) to associate with this release; useful if a tagged version has been provided.
ref.title: Ref

refs.description: Indicates or updates the start and end commits for each repository in a release. Head commits require ``repository`` and ``commit`` (HEAD SHA), and can optionally include ``previousCommit`` (SHA of previous release's HEAD) for initial data sends or corrections.

commit.description: The commit SHA (Secure Hash Algorithm) identifier for the head commit of this repository in the release.
commit.title: Commit

previousCommit.description: The commit SHA of the head of the previous release for this repository. This is useful for Sentry to determine the set of changes in the current release. It is recommended to include this if this is the first time you're sending commit data for this repository in a release.
previousCommit.title: Previous Commit

repository.description: The full name or identifier of the repository (e.g., 'my-org/my-repo').
repository.title: Repository

refs.title: Refs

url.description: A URL that points to the release. For instance, this can be the path to an online interface to the source code, such as a GitHub URL, or a link to a release announcement.
url.title: Url

version.description: The version identifier of the release to be updated (e.g., '1.0.0', 'my-project@2.3.12'). This identifier must be unique within the organization.
version.title: Version

name: update_release_details_for_organization

authors.description: List of commit authors for this release
authors.title: Authors

commitCount.description: Total number of commits associated with this release
commitCount.title: Commit Count

currentProjectMeta.description: Metadata specific to the current project
currentProjectMeta.title: Current Project Meta

data.description: Additional metadata associated with the release
data.title: Data

dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the release was created in Sentry
dateCreated.title: Date Created

dateReleased.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the release went live
dateReleased.title: Date Released

deployCount.description: Number of deploys for this release
deployCount.title: Deploy Count

firstEvent.description: Timestamp of the first event associated with this release
firstEvent.title: First Event

id.description: The unique ID of the release
id.title: Id

lastCommit.description: Information about the most recent commit in this release
lastCommit.title: Last Commit

lastDeploy.description: Information about the most recent deployment
lastDeploy.title: Last Deploy

lastEvent.description: Timestamp of the last event associated with this release
lastEvent.title: Last Event

newGroups.description: Number of new issue groups introduced in this release
newGroups.title: New Groups

projects.description: List of projects associated with this release
projects.title: Projects

ref.description: The commit reference (branch, tag, or SHA) associated with this release
ref.title: Ref

shortVersion.description: Shortened version of the release identifier
shortVersion.title: Short Version

url.description: URL pointing to the release (e.g., GitHub release page)
url.title: Url

userAgent.description: User agent string from the request that created/updated the release
userAgent.title: User Agent

version.description: The version identifier of the release
version.title: Version

data.description: Detailed information about the updated release, including version, commits, deployments, and associated projects.
data.title: Data
